tagline: Leading financial services provider for growing businesses and families
hero_kpi_rationale: Net income is the primary indicator of the bank's overall financial performance, reflecting its ability to generate profits from its operations, investments, and services.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit earned by the company after deducting all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income increased by 18% in 2025 compared to 2024, reaching $7.0 billion.
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth, indicating solid financial health.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of all revenues generated by the company's activities before deducting costs.
kpis.description: Total revenues increased by 7% in 2025 to reach $23.1 billion.
kpis.signal: Steady revenue growth, indicating business expansion.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned on assets and interest paid on liabilities.
kpis.description: Net interest income increased by 7% in 2025, reaching $14.4 billion, driven by lower funding costs and repricing of fixed-rate assets.
kpis.signal: Growth in interest income, supported by funding cost management and loan growth.

kpis.name: Noninterest Income
kpis.explanation: Income from non-interest sources such as fees and asset management revenues.
kpis.description: Noninterest income increased by 8% in 2025 to $8.7 billion, driven by capital markets, fees, and asset management.
kpis.signal: Revenue diversification, indicating a balanced growth strategy.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures the percentage of revenue used to cover operating expenses. A lower ratio indicates higher efficiency.
kpis.description: The efficiency ratio improved to 60% in 2025, compared to 63% in 2024, indicating better cost management.
kpis.signal: Improved operational efficiency, signaling better cost control.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans and other receivables.
kpis.description: The provision for credit losses was $779 million in 2025, slightly lower than $789 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Stable credit loss provisions, reflecting prudent credit risk management.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Total assets increased by 2.4% to $573.6 billion at the end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Moderate asset growth, indicating prudent business expansion.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits held by the bank.
kpis.description: Total deposits increased by 3.3% to $440.9 billion at the end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Deposit growth, indicating customer confidence and funding stability.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1)
kpis.explanation: The strictest capital ratio, measuring the bank's ability to absorb losses.
kpis.description: The common equity tier 1 (CET1) ratio was 10.6% at the end of 2025, slightly up from 10.5% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong and slightly improved CET1 ratio, indicating excellent solvency.

kpis.name: FDIC Special Assessment Provision Release
kpis.explanation: Release of provisions following the FDIC's downward revision of expected banking losses.
kpis.description: In 2025, PNC benefited from a $108 million release of provisions related to the FDIC special assessment, following a revision of expected losses (60M in Q4 and 48M in Q3).
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in FDIC special assessment charges in 2025, gain of $108 million.

kpis.name: Visa Exchange Program Gain
kpis.explanation: Exceptional gain realized from the conversion of Visa Class B-1 shares into Visa Class B-2 and Class C shares.
kpis.description: In the second quarter of 2024, PNC recorded a $754 million gain from converting its Visa Class B-1 shares into Visa Class C shares, while retaining Class B-2 shares.
kpis.signal: Significant one-time gain of $754 million from the Visa exchange program in Q2 2024.

kpis.name: Investment Securities Portfolio Repositioning Loss
kpis.explanation: Accounting loss realized from selling low-yielding securities to reinvest in higher-yielding securities.
kpis.description: In the second quarter of 2024, PNC recorded a $497 million loss from repositioning its investment securities portfolio, selling $3.8 billion of low-yielding securities and redeploying proceeds into higher-yielding securities.
kpis.signal: Accounting loss of $497 million related to portfolio optimization strategy in Q2 2024.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: PNC does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 10-K/20-F filing.
